name: figma-deep-dive
description: Claude Code plugin for reading and tidying Figma screens. The figma-deep-dive agent extracts distilled, structured specs from Figma node IDs while keeping main-context token usage low; /figma-screens audits and applies a screen naming convention (confirm-gated) and writes a 'Screens to build' section into a PRD. Self-installing: run /figma-setup to register the figma-console MCP, validate your Figma token, and connect the Desktop Bridge.
